LanguageData.DMS_VaultElevator.label: freight elevator
LanguageData.DMS_VaultElevator.description: The entrance to a buried military storage vault. The lift still has power, but its controls are locked. Hack it to bring the car up.
LanguageData.DMS_VaultElevator_Sealed.label: sealed freight elevator
LanguageData.DMS_VaultElevator_Sealed.description: The surface pad of a buried freight elevator, locked down under an armored cover plate. The shaft controls are tied to a nearby access console; swipe a key-card there to retract the cover and bring the car up.
LanguageData.DMS_VaultElevatorExit.label: freight elevator car
LanguageData.DMS_VaultElevatorExit.description: A lift car which links to the surface pad above.
LanguageData.DMS_MechCapsule_VaultInfantry.label: mothballed mech
LanguageData.DMS_MechCapsule_VaultInfantry.descriptio: A line infantry automatroid in hibernation mode, sealed in a storage cradle. The vault lost power before anyone came to collect it. A mechanitor can attempt to hack and control it.
LanguageData.DMS_MechCapsule_VaultAssault.label: mothballed mech
LanguageData.DMS_MechCapsule_VaultAssault.description: An assault-pattern automatroid in hibernation mode, clamped into a maintenance cradle with its actuator bays still open. The vault was sealed before the servicing was finished. A mechanitor can attempt to hack and control it.
LanguageData.DMS_MechCapsule_VaultFrame.label: mothballed battle frame
LanguageData.DMS_MechCapsule_VaultFrame.description: A battle frame in hibernation mode, pinned into a service gantry for long-term storage. Its command authentication expired with the unit that owned it. A mechanitor can attempt to hack and control it.
